name: Random Pool
description: Generates a pool of experimental conditions by randomly sampling from the defined variable space.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of random samples to generate from the variable space.

parameters.name: random_state
parameters.description: Seed for random number generator to ensure reproducibility.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: If true, allow repeated values in sampling.

inputDataType.name: variables
inputDataType.description: Variable collection defining the experimental space.
